## Assessment Summary

**Job:** DD-UARCH-L5 — Senior Staff Engineer, Microarchitecture (Digital Design family, engineering family_group, IC track, L5), target bonus 15%, standard equity tier.

**Market data:** Found an exact slice match (family_group=engineering, level_code=L5, geo_code=US-SJC), aged to 2026-08-01 at 3.5% growth. Survey rows list several family/sub-family codes but all share identical percentile figures at this level/geo, including the primary match SYN-044-DD-UARCH-L5 (18 incumbents, effective 2026-07-01): p25 ≈ $181,904, p50 ≈ $216,552 (aged to ≈ $217,174), p75 ≈ $255,532, p90 ≈ $290,180. Currency is USD, matching the candidate salary, so no FX conversion was needed.

**Candidate vs. market:** $210,000 sits just below the aged P50 (~$217,174) — roughly 97% of median, comfortably inside the P25–P75 band, closer to the middle than the bottom.

**Internal equity:** check_internal_equity returned zero peers for DD-UARCH-L5 in US-SJC — there are currently no incumbents in this exact job/geo combination to benchmark against, so no internal compa-ratio distribution is available.

**Range-based metrics:** No salary structure (range_min/mid/max) was available for this job/geo, so compute_pay_metrics could not be run against a formal range — only the market-percentile comparison above is available.

**Bottom line:** The $210,000 offer is essentially at/slightly below external market median for this exact level and location, with no internal comparators to check for equity concerns (none exist yet). No data gaps or missing-slice issues were encountered on the market side; the only gap is the absence of internal incumbents and of a formal range structure for a full compa-ratio calculation.
